# Workspace: `dn task` and `dn milestone`

Prefer `dn task` / `dn milestone` over ad-hoc HTTP or UI-only flows.

| Backend | Flag | Target |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Local queue | `--todo` | `~/.dn/todo.md` kickstart queue |
| GitHub | `--github` / `--gh` | Repo issues (`dn issue` equivalent) |
| Denoise Pro | `--denoise` | Cloud milestones/tasks on `denoise.cloud` |

`workspace.default_backend` in `dn.json` or `~/.dn/config.json`; explicit flags
win. `DN_WORKSPACE_BACKEND` in CI. `--api-url` / `workspace.api_url` for QA.

**Local:** `dn task --todo list|upsert|delete|done|sync status`

**GitHub:** `dn task --github …` or `dn issue …`

**Denoise:** `dn task create --milestone <uuid> --title …`, `list`, `show`,
`edit`, `close`, `reopen`, `done`. `dn milestone create|list|show|edit|archive`.
`dn task done --denoise <url>` closes cloud task + linked GitHub issue when
present.

`dn kickstart` accepts Denoise URLs (`/task/<uuid>`, `/t/<code>`) like issue
URLs (no `-A` unless linked GitHub issue is cross-repo).

Docs: https://docs.denoise.cloud/dn/workspace/

## Follow-up filing (after user approves)

Read `workspace.default_backend` and `harness_hints`. Active Denoise task URL in
thread → `dn task show --denoise <url>` for milestone, then:

```bash
dn task create --denoise --milestone <uuid> --title "Brief title" --body-file follow-up.md
```

GitHub-centric work:

```bash
dn task --github create --title "Brief title" --body-file follow-up.md
```

`--todo` / Personal queue only when the user explicitly wants it.

Optional link-back: `dn issue comment <parent-ref> --body-file note.md` or
`dn task --denoise edit …`.

### Issue body template

```md
## Summary
- ...

## Updated understanding
- ...

## Proposed next steps
- ...

## Open questions / risks
- ...
```

## Edit etiquette

- `dn issue show` / `dn task --github show` before editing GitHub issues.
- Denoise: `dn task show --denoise`, `dn task edit --denoise` (append via
  `--body-file`, not comment).
- GitHub: prefer `dn issue comment`; `dn issue edit` only when user wants body
  replaced.
